test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Five friends A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a circle facing towards centre. Their order of sitting must fulfill the following conditions:

1. A and C are immediate neighbours of each other.

2. C is the 2ⁿd person to the right of D.

3. A is not an immediate neighbour of D.

4. B sits 2ⁿd to the left of A.

What will be the position of E with respect to C?

options.text: E is second to the left of C
E is third to the right of C
E is second to the right of C
E is to immediate right of C

solution:
**SOLUTION:**

Step 1: A and C are immediate neighbors of each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da70d6e6b8a22a54d4b9c15c85ba26b83a78e88b37fe747b6a9e003957ff383e.png] 

Step 2: C is the 2nd person to the right of D.

Step 3: A is not an immediate neighbor of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3a64d4804e7c5e7181264ca10b13f0e60c8b885f9c77cc3897bb59516369b3a.png] 

Step 4: B sits 2nd to the left of A. Therefore the remaining spot is assigned to E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c5703f7a1966c30267ca26bc45837563e19554d3b9200a00189805dbd58734.png] 

With the help of the diagram, we can see that** E is second to the right of C.**
